messages.content: You write evaluation questions for an assistant that answers questions about Indian health-insurance rules issued by the regulator IRDAI. Questions must sound like a real policyholder, agent or claims officer asking. Never mention 'the passage', 'the circular above' or page numbers in a question. Answers are 1-3 plain sentences. Reply with JSON only.

Passage (from IRDAI Master Circular on Health Insurance Business (29 May 2024) | page 17):
"""
Further, express consent of the policyholder shall be obtained for sharing of medical records and any other related information in every instance. III. Submission of Returns: Insurers shall submit periodic returns on Premium, claims etc. as per the provisions of the master circular on submission of returns issued by the Competent Authority. IV. Repeal of the Guidelines /Circulars: This Circular supersedes all the Guidelines/Circulars listed in Annexure-6. ****
"""

Write up to 2 different questions that this passage alone fully answers. Prefer concrete rules: time limits, amounts, conditions, who must do what. If the passage is only boilerplate, headings or a form, return {"items": []}.
JSON: {"items": [{"question": str, "answer": str, "facts": [2-4 short spans copied word-for-word from the passage that the answer needs]}]}

content: {"items":[{"question":"Who is required to obtain express consent before sharing medical records and related information?","answer":"The insurer must obtain express consent from the policyholder before sharing any medical records or related information.","facts":["express consent of the policyholder shall be obtained for sharing of medical records and any other related information in every instance"]},{"question":"What periodic returns must insurers submit according to the IRDAI circular?","answer":"Insurers must submit periodic returns on premium, claims, etc., as per the provisions of the master circular on submission of returns issued by the Competent Authority.","facts":["Insurers shall submit periodic returns on Premium, claims etc. as per the provisions of the master circular on submission of returns issued by the Competent Authority"]}]}
